report: MINI cycle delivered all artifacts (Synthea v4.0.0 cohort install + 121-patient FHIR/CSV export + synthea_fhir_loader + 3 Path T cases + harness + REPORT) on Option A pivot scope (use existing mapping 41, no new validator authoring, forensic §4 instead of fresh Copilot session). End-to-end harness ran 3/3 cases through SDK→backend→etlp-mapper→council-v2 without unhandled exceptions. The §6.5 paper claim about worst-of composition with per-stage attribution DOES NOT replicate on FHIR Patient under the current architecture: (1) S-P1-20 NEW — council fires FABRICATED_HISTORY on all 3 cases including the clean baseline, because the FHIR Patient artifact carries US-Core-required structured fields the transcript doesn't verbalize verbatim; (2) S-P1-15 generalizes to FHIR — mapping 41's severity=HIGH finding does not translate to backend structural status=BLOCK. The harness produced 1/3 all-three-pass, but per-case attribution shows the wins are for wrong reasons (substitute matches, not strict-flag matches). REPORT §5 issues an explicit criteria-grounded NO-GO on P1-FHIR-CONFORMANCE-FULL until S-P1-15-fhir-extension lands AND either S-P1-20 lands or §6.5 paper measurement uses stripped Patient artifacts. The MINI cycle paid ~$0.10 + ~5 hours to derisk that exact spend.
